verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at the docs origin, Markdown versions of doc pages (.md), and a machine-readable openapi.json. The llms.txt content summarizes the agent-facing surfaces (x402, Edge API, MCP), and individual doc pages such as languages.md and create.md are served as Markdown for agents to consume. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent third-party report of agents successfully using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: With the x402 API, an AI agent pays per job in USDC on Base, with no API key. The Edge API transcribes short files synchronously, and an MCP server lets AI assistants transcribe.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.speechischeap.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
